description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Elvish Aberration.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Elvish Aberration.
Repeat.
